summary: Specifies the Subnetwork Encapsulation and Adaptation Layer (SEAL), which is meant for virtual topologies built by encapsulating packets between border nodes. Such tunnels can introduce failure modes like packet duplication and links with differing Maximum Transmission Units. SEAL is an experimental mechanism for handling these issues.

eli5.summary: When packages travel through a tunnel with different-sized doors, some do not fit or arrive twice. This experimental plan wraps the packages so they get through the tunnel in good order.
